summary_1line: Drupada urges rapid alliance-building for war, Krishna advises a final peace message, and both sides begin gathering vast armies across the land.

image_candidates.scene_text: Messengers ride out in all directions from the courts of the Pandavas and their allies, carrying urgent summons to distant kings.
Armies from many kingdoms march across the land, their chariots, elephants, and banners making the earth seem to tremble.
King Drupada instructs his aged priest to travel to the Kuru court and deliver a grave message about peace or war.
